title: Page build event
description: A `build` event whose `data` is JSON `{ build }`. Sent only when the server runs in watch mode.

build.description: Names the page the server is serving now. It changes when the server restarts or the page is rebuilt; a page that sees a different value reloads.

data.description: JSON text `{ "build": <id> }`: the current build of the page.

retry.description: How many milliseconds a client waits before it reconnects.
